 Questions continue to be asked over the meaningfulness of Man City ’s domestic matches as they await the outcome of their appeal against their guilty verdict for financial misconduct. When a final punishment is dished out, their seven successive victories at the start of the campaign could effectively count for nothing. 
--> Questions continue to be asked over the meaningfulness of Man City ’s domestic matches as they await the outcome of their appeal against their guilty verdict for financial misconduct. When a final punishment is dished out, their seven successive victories at the start of the campaign could effectively count for nothing. 
 But for the time being, the show must go on. 
--> But for the time being, the show must go on. 
 City have been undeniably efficient on the field during their perfect Premier League streak, even if Enzo Maresca’s side still lack the imperiousness exhibited by previous iterations under Pep Guardiola. They have already conquered Man Utd and Liverpool on their travels, and now they must bypass a resurgent Aston Villa team. 
--> City have been undeniably efficient on the field during their perfect Premier League streak, even if Enzo Maresca’s side still lack the imperiousness exhibited by previous iterations under Pep Guardiola. They have already conquered Man Utd and Liverpool on their travels, and now they must bypass a resurgent Aston Villa team. 
 Unai Emery has seemingly mastered another rebuild at Villa Park, with five victories across the previous six outings. They will undoubtedly push City to their limits on Saturday, boosted by three straight home wins in this fixture. 
--> Unai Emery has seemingly mastered another rebuild at Villa Park, with five victories across the previous six outings. They will undoubtedly push City to their limits on Saturday, boosted by three straight home wins in this fixture. 
 However, with Erling Haaland, Rayan Cherki and Phil Foden all entering the match in encouraging form, one would be brave to bet against the undefeated Cityzens. 
--> However, with Erling Haaland, Rayan Cherki and Phil Foden all entering the match in encouraging form, one would be brave to bet against the undefeated Cityzens.

They managed just one shot on target at the City Ground last Sunday, despite claiming all three points.

They managed just one shot on target at the City Ground last Sunday, despite claiming all three points.

Álvaro Arbeloa’s men, meanwhile, secured impressive draws with Liverpool and Manchester United before the international break, and finally clinched a first league win by beating Hull City last time out. 
--> Coventry have won two of their last three matches, moving them out of the relegation zone and a point above Fulham. Álvaro Arbeloa’s men, meanwhile, secured impressive draws with Liverpool and Manchester United before the international break, and finally clinched a first league win by beating Hull City last time out. 
 This is unlikely to be a thriller between two of the division’s lowest scorers, but it’s an encounter which could have enormous ramifications come the end of the season.
